description: Defines the ClientManager class implementing IClientManager interface for Android media buffer pool, including methods for creating connections, registering senders, allocating buffers, receiving buffers, posting transactions, and cleanup.

classes.name: ClientManager
classes.description: Implements IClientManager interface, manages buffer pool client connections, buffer allocations, and transactions.

methods.name: registerSender
methods.description: Registers a sender buffer pool with a remote receiver.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of ClientManager.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new local buffer pool connection.

methods.name: registerSender
methods.description: Registers a created connection as sender for remote process.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a buffer from a connection.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Receives a buffer for a transaction.

methods.name: postSend
methods.description: Posts a buffer transfer transaction to the buffer pool.
